The hamster has dense, short golden-orange fur, a stocky compact body, and is facing slightly to the right. Its head features prominent cheek pouches, small dark eyes, and rounded ears. A faint watermark or text artifact is visible in the bottom left corner.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark/black, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible on top of the head, appearing rounded and proportionally large relative to the head size.
